chunks: And it was narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام regarding the muhrim using the tooth-stick; he said: "Yes."
He said: I said, "What if he causes bleeding and uses the tooth-stick?" He said: "Yes, it is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition)."

key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the established prophetic tradition and recommended practice
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj (pilgrimage) or ʿumrah
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative ruling meaning yes, it is allowed
key_terms.يَسْتَاكُ: uses the miswak or tooth-stick to clean the teeth

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim use a miswak if it causes bleeding?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a muhrim may use the miswak (tooth-stick) while in ihram. Even if using it causes slight bleeding, it remains permitted because it is part of the sunnah (prophetic tradition).
